title: Zach’s Beyond Vanilla
description: Experience vanilla+ the way you always imagined it could be.
body:
Welcome to the Ultimate Vanilla+ Minecraft Adventure Pack!

Ready to transform your Minecraft experience into something extraordinary? Dive into a world brimming with fresh features, thrilling new challenges, and endless fun with our custom modpack, crafted with love for friends and fellow players alike!

Here’s some of what awaits you in this epic modded journey:

🌍 Waystones: Discover ancient waystones scattered across villages, towers, and dungeons. Activate them to unlock fast travel and conquer the world with ease, all while spending a bit of your experience!

🔍 EMI Inventory Management: Keep track of all the goodies you’ve gathered! EMI’s got you covered with a comprehensive item and recipe list right in your inventory.

🗣️ Voice Chat: Engage with your friends using our seamless voice chat feature. Press Left Alt to talk, Backspace to mute, and V to adjust your proximity chat settings.

⚰️ Graves: No more stressful corpse runs! When you die, a protective grave spawns, keeping your items safe for 15 minutes—giving you peace of mind and time to recover.

🏰 Revamped Structures: Explore a world rich with revamped mineshafts, temples, fortresses, and floating villages. Each structure is brimming with new challenges and treasures!

🔥 Healing Campfires: Light up your nights with campfires that heal you within their warm glow. Perfect for those cozy gatherings around the fire!

🌾 Better Harvesting: Enjoy a smoother farming experience with the ability to harvest and replant crops with a single click. Farming has never been so efficient!

🗺️ Chunk Protection: Safeguard your builds with the fullscreen map. Claim and protect your chunks effortlessly and control who can interact with your creations.

💻 ComputerCraft: Get tech-savvy with ComputerCraft! Build a mainframe, program it with Lua, and automate your world like a true tech wizard.

💬 Health Bars: Keep track of mob health with convenient health bars displayed above their heads. Adjust settings with ease using the H key.

🎵 Custom Music Discs: Add a personal touch to your world with custom music discs. Fill your Minecraft days with your favorite tunes!

🎨 Custom Paintings: Express your creativity with the Wicked Paintings mod. Decorate your spaces with custom art that truly reflects your style.

🎒 Traveler’s Backpack: Need more space for your adventures? The Traveler’s Backpack has you covered with extra inventory space and unique features.

🛏️ Revamped Sleep: Experience a new dimension of sleep with hammocks, enhanced home bed benefits, and even a touch of nightmare intrigue. Bed bugs are temporarily off the menu!

🔧 Other Cool New Features: From picking up chests and players to diagonal fences and chains, this pack is filled with innovative tweaks that enhance your Minecraft experience. Download the pack to discover more new features!

Dive in, explore, and enjoy all the surprises and enhancements packed into this Vanilla+ modpack. Whether you're teaming up with friends or embarking on solo adventures, there’s always something new to discover. Have fun, and happy crafting!

A huge shoutout to the talented modders who made this possible. For any credit or removal requests, reach out to me on Discord @zaaacchh.

Let the adventure begin! 🚀

---
Notes:
Just a pack I put together for my friends. I do not take credit for any included mods. See credit section below.


- **Default resource pack**: You can customize the Sphax resource pack here -> [https://bdcraft.net/downloads/purebdcraft-minecraft/customiser/](https://bdcraft.net/downloads/purebdcraft-minecraft/customiser/)
- **Optional mods**: There are some mods that are fun to have that are client-side/singleplayer that can be enabled in the modpack settings. Just know that immersive portals is incompatible with Iris/shaders and WILL break in single/multiplayer.
